keyDecisions.decision: Extracted messageNamesStatusFixtureQueued as a small helper instead of inlining three && chained strings.Contains calls.
keyDecisions.reasoning: Analysis task 5 calls for extracting a helper if the new assertion needs more than one or two checks; naming it also makes the failure message's own Fatalf read cleanly and keeps the test function free of an unnamed boolean expression.

keyDecisions.decision: Checked the AC3 negative control manually during implementation (weakened assertVocabularyMatches's Errorf format string, reran TestVocabularyCheckCatchesAMismatch, saw it fail, then restored the original string exactly) rather than leaving that verification solely to QA.
